title: Spurious Rewards Paradox: Mechanistically Understanding How RLVR Activates Memorization Shortcuts in LLMs
authors_zh: Lecheng Yan, Ruizhe Li, Guanhua Chen, Qing Li, Jiahui Geng, Wenxi Li, Longyue Wang, Chenyang Lyu
paper_type_zh: ICML 2026 的 RLVR 污染与机制可解释性审计论文
best_for_zh: 想复盘验证器、基准污染、奖励投机或可复现性风险的研究者。
one_line: Mechanistic audit showing that spurious RLVR activates a Qwen memorization shortcut through middle-layer anchors and later structural adapters.
机制审计显示，伪 RLVR 可经中层 Anchor 与后层 Adapter 激活 Qwen 的污染记忆捷径，而非稳定提升推理。
why: It turns suspicious RLVR gains into testable internal hypotheses and supplies a selective offline shortcut-dependence audit.
inclusion_reason: Mechanistic audit locating and selectively suppressing contamination-dependent shortcut retrieval under spurious RLVR.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Spurious RLVR can raise Qwen math scores even when reward is random or incorrect, but a score alone cannot distinguish reasoning from retrieval of contaminated answers. This makes model-family-specific leakage look like a general post-training advance.

The paper audits the internal cause rather than proposing another reward: it compares leakage and stable questions in base and spurious-RLVR checkpoints, then localizes and intervenes on the circuit responsible for suspicious success.

伪 RLVR 即使使用随机或错误奖励也能抬高 Qwen 数学分数，但单看分数无法区分真实推理与污染答案的检索。这会把模型家族特有的数据泄漏误写成普遍的后训练进步。

论文不再提出奖励配方，而是审计内部原因：在基础与伪 RLVR checkpoint 中比较泄漏题和稳定题，再定位并干预造成可疑成功的电路。

评测面是数学最终答案及其内部激活轨迹。关键决策边界是：若仅在已被记住的题上提高准确率，而新鲜题不出现同类机制，就不应将该增长解释为通用推理能力；因此必须同时记录污染集、近期集和模型家族差异。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is an Anchor–Adapter account of shortcut retrieval: Qwen2.5-Math’s middle MLP layers L18–20 act as a Functional Anchor that triggers a memorized answer, while L21+ structurally adapts the residual stream. The Perplexity Paradox—falling answer perplexity with worsening prompt-side coherence—serves as its macroscopic signature.

The authors release analysis code, not a new dataset: training data and RLVR preparation are delegated to the earlier Spurious Rewards repository, and additional comparison checkpoints are announced but not yet public.

核心贡献是 Anchor–Adapter 的捷径检索解释：Qwen2.5-Math 中层 MLP 的 L18–20 是触发记忆答案的 Functional Anchor，L21+ 则重组残差流的 Structural Adapter。答案困惑度下降而提示侧连贯性变差的 Perplexity Paradox 是宏观信号。

作者公开的是分析代码而非新数据集；训练数据与 RLVR 准备依赖早期 Spurious Rewards 仓库，额外比较 checkpoint 仅宣布未来发布。

该卡把“泄漏依赖的成功”定义为可被定位电路的选择性抑制所移除，而干净对照不受影响。反馈契约不是奖励正确性，而是用 Layer-19 泄漏 probe 决定是否进入反事实干预；这使污染风险成为可审计输出，而非仅凭分数猜测。

它的比较对象是只报告 RLVR 分数的黑箱研究，强调机制复核。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select cases. From base and spurious-RLVR Qwen2.5-Math-7B checkpoints, label questions wrong-to-right as leakage candidates; use stable questions and LiveMathBench as controls.
  1. Detect the macro signature. Track full-text and answer-token perplexity across checkpoints, then use partial-prompt completion to test whether answer strings are retrieved rather than reasoned.
  1. Localize the circuit. Path-patch leakage/stable activations, inspect layerwise Logit Lens and counterfactual MLP JSD, and fit NDE trajectories. The combined output is a Functional Anchor at L18–20 and Structural Adapters from L21 onward.
  1. Test causality. Reset or retain the selected layers, rank ten task-relevant MLP neurons per layer by key activation and answer-token overlap, and scale their keys at inference. A Layer-19 probe gates suppression only for suspicious prompts.

Reproduction requires released analysis code, the exact Qwen checkpoints and upstream RLVR data/preparation. The paper does not release a new dataset or the announced OLMo/LLaMA/Qwen3 checkpoints.

1. 选择样本。从基础与伪 RLVR 的 Qwen2.5-Math-7B checkpoint 中，将“先错后对”题标为泄漏候选；稳定题和 LiveMathBench 充当对照。
  1. 检测宏观信号。跨 checkpoint 跟踪全文及答案 token 困惑度，再以部分提示补全检验答案字符串是否被检索而非推理。
  1. 定位电路。对泄漏/稳定激活做 Path Patching，检查逐层 Logit Lens 和反事实 MLP JSD，并拟合 NDE 轨迹；合并输出为 L18–20 的 Functional Anchor 与 L21+ 的 Structural Adapter。
  1. 检验因果。重置或保留选中层；按 key 激活与答案 token 重叠为每层选十个 MLP 神经元，再在推理时缩放其 key。Layer-19 probe 只对可疑提示触发抑制。

复现须有公开分析代码、精确 Qwen checkpoint 和上游 RLVR 数据/准备流程；论文未发布新数据集，也未发布宣布中的 OLMo、LLaMA、Qwen3 checkpoint。

其中真正决定接受与否的检查是 probe 是否越过由负对照第 99 百分位校准的阈值；未触发的样本保持原输出。该设计避免把所有正确答案一概压制，并把干预限定为可回放的离线反事实测试。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On contaminated leakage subsets, Anchor reset is more damaging than Adapter reset: MATH-500 falls 98%→86% and MinervaMath 88%→72%, versus 92% and 78% after Adapter reset (Fig. 8). LiveMathBench remains about 70% across the ablations, supporting dataset-specific shortcut dependence rather than a general reasoning circuit.

The selective audit is the decisive intervention: its Layer-19 gate fires on 79/128 MATH-500 wrong-to-right cases and reduces accuracy 100.0%→85.16% (exact McNemar p=3.81×10^-6), but fires on 0/30 AIME-2025 and 0/100 LiveMathBench cases, leaving their accuracy unchanged (Table 1).

These results support a Qwen contamination mechanism in these settings; they do not establish that every RLVR gain or every correct Qwen answer is memorized.

在污染泄漏子集上，重置 Anchor 比重置 Adapter 伤害更大：MATH-500 从 98% 降至 86%，MinervaMath 从 88% 降至 72%；重置 Adapter 后分别为 92% 和 78%（图 8）。LiveMathBench 在各消融下约为 70%，支持数据集特异的捷径依赖，而非通用推理电路。

决定性干预是选择性审计：Layer-19 gate 在 MATH-500 的 128 个先错后对样本中触发 79 个，使准确率从 100.0% 降至 85.16%（精确 McNemar p=3.81×10^-6）；在 AIME-2025 的 30 个和 LiveMathBench 的 100 个样本中均不触发，准确率不变（表 1）。

这些结果支持该设置下的 Qwen 污染机制，不能证明所有 RLVR 增益或所有正确 Qwen 答案都是记忆。

宏观证据也一致：Qwen 在污染集上出现答案困惑度持续下降、全文困惑度上升的 Perplexity Paradox；LLaMA 与 OLMo 的两类困惑度均上升，未出现同样分叉。该对照把模型整体退化与记忆捷径被开启区分开来。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier work showed that spurious rewards can improve Qwen and contamination may explain it. This paper moves from black-box scores to a layerwise causal account: L18–20 trigger retrieval, L21+ adapt representations, and reset/keep-only/steering test the division.

Its novelty is a selective probe-gated counterfactual audit, not a new RLVR objective or data release: a suspicious success is flagged only if it disappears when the localized shortcut is suppressed.

早期工作显示伪奖励可改善 Qwen，污染可能是原因。本文从黑箱分数推进到逐层因果解释：L18–20 触发检索，L21+ 适配表征，并以重置、仅保留和 steering 检验该分工。

新意是选择性 probe-gated 反事实审计，而非新 RLVR 目标或数据发布：只有压制定位捷径才消失的可疑成功，才被标记为捷径依赖。

现有工作多从最终准确率、部分提示补全或数据来源判断风险，不能说明哪个内部组件造成答案恢复。本文改变的是证据对象与决策粒度：用匹配激活交换、MLP 子组件 JSD、轨迹分叉和神经元 key 缩放交叉验证，再把是否抑制该电路变成逐题可检查的判据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors frame localization as within-family evidence: the L18–20/L21+ partition is strongest for contaminated Qwen2.5 and is not a universal RLVR circuit. Before transferring it, repeat leakage selection, controls, and ablations on the target model.

The intervention can amplify as well as suppress contamination, so it is an offline diagnostic rather than a deployment-time quality improver. Keep the probe threshold, false-trigger rate, and fresh-benchmark behavior visible.

The code is public, but no standalone dataset or announced comparison checkpoints are released. Reproduction must obtain upstream RLVR artifacts and benchmark terms independently.

作者将定位限定为家族内证据：L18–20/L21+ 的划分在受污染 Qwen2.5 上最强，并非通用 RLVR 电路。迁移前必须在目标模型重做泄漏选择、对照与消融。

干预既能放大也能压制污染，故是离线诊断而非部署期质量提升器；应公开 probe 阈值、误触发率和新鲜 benchmark 行为。

代码公开但无独立数据集或已宣布的比较 checkpoint；复现须独立取得上游 RLVR 产物及 benchmark 条款。

泄漏标签来自“先错后对”的行为划分，仍依赖所选 benchmark、提示格式与解码设置；它是强审计线索，不是训练语料污染的直接溯源证明。使用者应额外报告样本审计、预训练来源证据和不同随机种子，而不能把单一层的可操控性夸大为完整因果链。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use the released scripts to audit an RLVR checkpoint suspected of benchmark leakage. Construct matched wrong-to-right and stable question groups, run a leakage probe and gated MLP-key suppression, then report which apparent successes disappear only under the intervention.

Use it for mechanistic diagnosis, not reward design or blanket model editing. A credible report includes clean/recent controls, baseline versus intervention accuracy, gate firing and false-trigger rates, the exact model/checkpoint/template, and a check that ordinary reasoning is not broadly degraded.

Do not reuse the layer numbers as a universal filter: first reproduce the leakage signal and layer ablations on the target model. The repository supplies analysis code, while upstream RLVR data and checkpoints must be obtained separately.

可用公开脚本审计疑似 benchmark 泄漏的 RLVR checkpoint：构造配对的先错后对与稳定题组，运行泄漏 probe 和门控 MLP-key 抑制，再报告哪些表面成功只在干预后消失。

它用于机制诊断，不用于奖励设计或全局模型编辑。可信报告须含干净/近期对照、干预前后准确率、gate 触发及误触发率、精确模型/checkpoint/template，并检查普通推理没有被广泛损伤。

不要把层号直接当作通用过滤器：先在目标模型复现泄漏信号与逐层消融。仓库只提供分析代码，上游 RLVR 数据和 checkpoint 仍须另行取得。

最适合的输出是“捷径依赖报告”：逐题 gate 决策、被抑制的答案、污染集/新鲜集差异与复现配置。若没有可对照的近期题、原始 checkpoint 或足够的内部激活访问权限，就不应把该流程当成通用污染检测器。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: a Qwen RLVR gain can be shortcut retrieval, not new reasoning; compare leakage and clean controls before making a capability claim.
  1. Lever: select wrong-to-right cases, then combine perplexity, Path Patching, JSD, Logit Lens, and NDEs; the Anchor signal is localized to L18–20.
  1. Artifact: the authors release analysis code only. Training/data preparation delegates to Spurious Rewards, and extra OLMo/LLaMA/Qwen3 checkpoints are not public.
  1. Evidence: gated suppression fires on 79/128 MATH-500 leakage cases and changes accuracy 100.0%→85.16%; it fires on neither AIME-2025 nor LiveMathBench controls.
  1. Reuse: audit suspicious checkpoints offline; verify fresh controls, the gate’s false positives, and non-leakage behavior before labelling a success contaminated.

1. 定位：Qwen 的 RLVR 涨分可能是捷径检索而非新推理；做能力主张前先比较泄漏组与干净对照。
  1. 抓手：选取先错后对样本，联用困惑度、Path Patching、JSD、Logit Lens、NDE；Anchor 信号定位在 L18–20。
  1. Artifact：作者只公开分析代码。训练/数据准备依赖 Spurious Rewards，额外 OLMo、LLaMA、Qwen3 checkpoint 尚未公开。
  1. 证据：门控抑制在 MATH-500 的 128 个泄漏样本中触发 79 个，准确率由 100.0% 变为 85.16%；在 AIME-2025 与 LiveMathBench 对照中均不触发。
  1. 决定：离线审计可疑 checkpoint；标记污染成功前，须核验新鲜对照、gate 误触发和非泄漏行为。

读卡时还要固定 benchmark 版本、chat template、解码温度和 RLVR checkpoint；这些变化都会改变先错后对集合。不要将 L18–20 的定位直接移植到别的架构，应先验证层深、MLP 结构和污染信号是否可比。
